body_es: El Product Backlog es la fuente única de verdad para todas las características, mejoras y correcciones que se necesitan en el producto. El Product Owner es responsable de crearlo, mantenerlo priorizado y garantizar que el equipo comprenda cada elemento. La gestión efectiva del backlog implica refinamiento regular (agregar detalles y estimaciones), reordenamiento basado en valor del negocio y urgencia, y eliminación de elementos obsoletos. Un backlog bien mantenido reduce la confusión, acelera la toma de decisiones de sprint planning, y asegura que el equipo siempre trabaja en lo más valioso.
body_en: The Product Backlog is the single source of truth for all features, improvements, and fixes needed in the product. The Product Owner is responsible for creating it, keeping it prioritized, and ensuring the team understands each item. Effective backlog management involves regular refinement (adding details and estimates), reordering based on business value and urgency, and removing obsolete items. A well-maintained backlog reduces confusion, accelerates sprint planning decisions, and ensures the team always works on the most valuable things.
example_code:
# Product Backlog Management (YAML)
product_backlog:
  version: "v2.5"
  last_updated: "2026-09-26"
  total_items: 87
  
  backlog_items:
    - item_id: "PB-001"
      title: "User authentication"
      priority: 1
      business_value: "Critical"
      story_points: 8
      status: "Refined"
      owner: "Product Owner"
    
    - item_id: "PB-002"
      title: "Dashboard analytics"
      priority: 2
      business_value: "High"
      story_points: 13
      status: "Refined"
    
    - item_id: "PB-003"
      title: "Export to CSV"
      priority: 5
      business_value: "Medium"
      story_points: 5
      status: "Needs Refinement"
    
    - item_id: "PB-087"
      title: "Theme customization"
      priority: 87
      business_value: "Low"
      story_points: null
      status: "Not yet estimated"
  
  refinement_process:
    frequency: "Weekly"
    participants: "Product Owner + Development Team"
    activities:
      - "Estimate new stories"
      - "Break down large stories"
      - "Prioritize based on feedback"
      - "Remove obsolete items"
  
  ready_for_sprint: "Items 1-15 meet definition of ready"
  quality_gate: "Stories in top 10 are fully refined"
